brief:
Israeli forces on Wednesday forcibly evacuated two Palestinian families from a residential building in the town of Yabad, located southwest of Jenin in the northern occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The military subsequently converted the structure into a military barracks, displacing the residents who had lived there.

The evacuation was part of a wider operation across the West Bank that included additional arrests of Palestinians and raids on homes in other locations. The incidents reflect the ongoing military operations that Israeli forces conduct throughout Palestinian-controlled areas of the territory.
